liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Bobby's voice lacks strength in the opener, but the reviewer finds it still worth hearing [14]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Described as lucid and well connected, with Jerry's high-pitched solo embellishments standing out around the six-minute mark [14]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Cumberland leads into Mexicali, a pairing the reviewer calls unique, and a treat [15]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song contains a powerful jam, and The Music Never Stopped closes the first set [15]
- **Never Trust A Woman** (1 review): Reviewer says the song labeled Good Times is actually Never Trust a Woman [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-08-12 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t02 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t03 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t04 Never Trust A Woman**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t05 Cumberland Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t06 Mexicali Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t07 Friend Of The Devil**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]
- **gd87-08-12 t08 My Brother Esau**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-12.142089.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 140 min [1]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.miller.95684.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 139 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1987-08-12.aud.painoman.17354.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 134 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording by Paino judged the only AUD rivaling a Walker-Scotton-Miller soundboard release [17]
- **gd1987-08-12.163610.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 139 min [4]
- **gd87-08-12.nak.willy.14911.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 134 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with pretty good quality, which surprised the reviewer; still wishes for a soundboard or Healy mix [13]
- **gd1987-08-12.nak100.pasternak.81967.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 134 min [8]
- **gd1987-08-12.nakcm304.beckham.suraci.82054.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 131 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [11]. Said about its sound: Clear sound with good vocals, audible Phil bass and plenty of guitar and keys; slight hiss, unnoticeable during playing [15]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81677.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [12]. Said about its sound: Praised as an excellent soundboard transfer [19]

## Around the show

- The set begins with about 100 seconds of tuning before the first song [14]
- Rain threatened when the gates opened, but clouds parted over the hill behind the amphitheater just before the first set [20]
- Attendee was up front with friends from Crested Butte, on the second night, and found Bobby very intense [21]
- Attendee found this show more fun and relaxed than the first night, having had the day off [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-12.142089.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC3/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.miller.95684.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master [2]. Also: Soundboard to cassette master to cassette; pitch correction done with help from Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd1987-08-12.aud.painoman.17354.sbeok.shnf**: taped by unknown; transferred by Painoman; source: AUD(Nak CM-100s)>CASS>DAT>CDR [3]
- **gd1987-08-12.163610.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd87-08-12.nak.willy.14911.sbeok.shnf**: source: Nak CM 100>MC>DAT>CD [7]
- **gd1987-08-12.nak100.pasternak.81967.sbeok.flac16**: source: Nakamichi CM-100's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Marantz 420 cassette deck, with Dolby On [8]. Also: Same source as ShnID 14911 but MAC to CD lineage; tape flip in Space mended, first Quinn notes clipped [8]
- **gd1987-08-12.nakcm304.beckham.suraci.82054.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Don Beckham - Tony Suraci; source: Nak CM304's>Sony D5M [11]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81677.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Maxell XLIIS) [12]
